title: Going Further Back: The Pluperfect
goal: Use the pluperfect to step back from the main line of a story and explain what had happened before.

items: I can use the pluperfect to say what had already happened before a moment in a story.
I can give the earlier cause of a situation in a story.
I can use the new words for events and what came before.
